text:
maria: FYI we just got a heads-up from finance — the H100 bulk (50 units) ETA slipped. vendor rep: yep, sorry — customs in FRA flagged HS reclass on the shipment, needs paperwork.
vendor_rep: quick summary: forwarder held AWB 123-4567890, customs asking for clarified HS code and end‑use docs.
ops-bot: ticket #INC-3321 created for customs hold + RMA follow-up.
ajay: rough ETA change? how many days? this affects Dedicated pool scaling next week.
vendor_rep: currently estimating 5–8 business days after we provide corrected HS (we pushed an update to FRA broker).
liam: are we getting partial releases (some crates cleared) or full hold? can we re-route to AMS?
vendor_rep: FRA only cleared 10 units for now (crate IDs C-101..C-110). rest still on hold. Re-route adds 48–72h and extra fees.
ana: @ana — any short-term mitigations on infra side? can we reassign capacity or favor A800 fallbacks?
ana: (typo intended) I mean ana.
ana: @maria @ajay we can temporarily shift some non-latency workloads to A800s quantized profiles, but throughput drops ~30%. Need greenlight for config change.
ajay: ok do that for batch jobs, prioritize low‑SLO routes for fallback. keep latency-critical on existing pool.
liam: vendor_rep — on the crates that cleared, do we have RMA labels / serial map for the 10 units so we can pre-stage?
vendor_rep: sending CSV with serials + provisional RMA labels in 15m. will also propose a partial credit for delay; awaiting procurement approval.
maria: please include invoice line items and the proposed credit % so finance can pre-approve.
vendor_rep: will attach: `invoice_line=H100-2025-50`, `proposed_credit=4%` and broker contact.
liam: also need photos for depot acceptance (internal). vendor_rep can you push dock photos once crates inspected?
vendor_rep: yes, will upload photos to the ticket and cc your ops email.
ana: ops note — when we flip traffic to A800s, watch token cost delta and perf regressions, push alerts to #eng-runtime if >10% tail latency increase.
ajay: good call. maria, keeping schedule: if FRA clears within 8 days we'll avoid purchasing spot replacements. otherwise we need to discuss expedited buy vs. re‑route costs.
maria: understood. vendor_rep, please ping here when CSV + photos are in INC-3321. thanks. :pray:
vendor_rep: will do. thanks everyone.
